title: Task Records
prompt: Define a dataclass Task(title, done=False). Then implement finish(tasks) that returns a NEW list where every task is replaced by a copy with done=True. Use dataclasses.replace.

tests.name: all tasks done in the new list
tests.code:
ts = [Task('a'), Task('b', True)]
out = finish(ts)
assert all(t.done for t in out)
tests.hint: replace(t, done=True) copies with the field changed.

tests.name: original list untouched
tests.code:
ts = [Task('a')]
finish(ts)
assert ts[0].done is False
tests.hint: Build a new list; do not mutate the input tasks.
